notes.title: Update! And more...
notes.content:
This is the first update, in preparation for a major one which will bring 
brand new challenging and smart AIs, new places to explore and finally new game modes!

[b]Which game modes?[/b]
I'm planning to add a "Patrol" mode and a "Delivery" mode, I will better explain the details in a later moment.

Anyway, If you have ideas on game modes you'd like to see, I'm open to suggestions.

[b]How it will work?[/b]
Firstly I'll make some upgrades and adaptions to the game, such as this update.
Once everything will be ready, I'll push it in closed beta, if then it will work ok, I'll finally add the new modes in the default branch to be played by everyone.

[b]If any of you is interested in entering the closed beta, feel free to add me
to your friend list and to write me in chat.[/b]

[b]What's in this update?[/b]
You will find three new, huge maps, some missions improvements, new clouds an much more!
I really suggest to read the changelog and find out what's new and what's fixed.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
- Added Rocky Reef arena.
- Added Polar Scape arena.
- Added Mesas arena.
- Added new joystick configurations.
- Updated and improved the clouds.
- Various preparations for new AI.
- Added Skip Mission button.
- Slightly improved aircraft physics.
- Slightly Updated AI, in preparation of refactor.
- Performance optimizations.
- Improved graphics.
- Preparations for new AI in arena modes.
- Improved random spawnpoint positions.
- Made Mission 9 more playable.
- Improved Mission 10 to be more playable.
- Improved visibility in mission 3.
- Lowered default blur amount.
- Improvements to Last mission boss projectiles.
- Controls updates.
- Corrected lights in HUB.
- Changed Main Menu buttons text.

[b]Most Relevant Fixes:[/b]
- Fix for error with map bitmap corruption
- Jet cutoff fix.
- Fix for drones/bosses/interactive objects.
- Fixed potential crash and memory leak.
- Fix for zoomed in videos(confirmation apreciated).
- Fixed potential crashes.
- Fix for joystick mouse emulation.
- Fixed ceiling in mission 1.
- Fix bug with cutscenes.
- Small fix in hub text for expansions.
- Disable motionblur if we are showing a cutscene.
- Fixed gamebreaking bug in Mission 10.

As always, if you experience any bugs or issues, just let me know in the forums and I will eventually fix it!

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Update is now live!
notes.content:
A huge thanks to everyone who has given me feedback and for making this update possible.

The main feature in this build is a refactor of the rendering calls. These are now way faster, giving the game a big performance boost.

The graphics have also been improved and tidied up, with new light and specularity.

Since the game left Early Access and had its full launch, I have received loads of awesome feature requests and I have done my very best to implement them all. If I have missed your, I apologise!

Here are the most important changes and new features:

- Rendering calls refactor.
- New light falloff.
- New specularity.
- Improvements to guided projectiles.
- Better ship maneuvering.
- Skip cutscenes key (you can bind it in the controls menu).
- Basic Instructions screen.
- Controls curves.
- Controls profiles.
- Xbox360 controller fixes.
- Better balancing on MsM for kill.
- Weapon ready/range indicators.
- 2 new weapons.
- Adjustable camera distance.
- Better FOV.
- New loading UI.
- Locked target marker.
- Fix for savegames sometimes being overwritten by game updates.
- Fix crash on launch on Nvidia cards with 361.75 driver.
- Multiple bug fixes throughout the game.

notes.title: AX:EL has left Early Access!
notes.content:
AX:EL has now left Early Access.

[b]A big thank you to the AX:EL community,
who gave awesome feedback and helped with making AX:EL as we know it.[/b]


The game has grown a lot since its first appearance on Early Access:

Ship customisation now gives huge freedom and allows you to create your own vehicle with a unique setup.
From wing colors to their rotation, each wing with its unique stats for air maneuvering,underwater
maneuvering, energy regeneration and more.

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/games/1/28/27899/319830_screenshots_2015-10-15_00002.jpg[/img]


The campaign mode had a complete rewrite with a deeper story, mission briefings,landings and take-offs.
There's even the cockpit view for full-immersion into the dogfigths.

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/games/1/28/27899/1435680253_screenshot_002-00021.png[/img]

The arena mode, with up to 32 bots and the possibility to play over direct IP or LAN with other
players now features Team Deathmatch.


The actual combat has improved a lot, too. It's now more strategic, allowing you to deploy countermeasures
or the energy shield to protect you. but beware, the AIs are now smarter and more challenging, too!

To help you with you flight, ships are now equipped with the "N.A.E.L.".
A special processing unit that gains experience based on how you fly, dive, or your tactics in combat. 
Essentially the system will "learn" how you fly and configure the ship to give better performance.
So even flying around alone just to "train" it, will make your ship more adaptable to your way to maneuver it.

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/games/1/28/27899/screenshot_004-00001.1.png[/img]

[b]What's next?[/b]
There are still things to come, the Beta build will soon be open to everyone to see in preview
new features and cool addons!

Thank you all for your support and keep enjoying with AX:EL - Air XenoDawn.

notes.title: Big Update!![Update 2.99c3.39]
notes.content:
Finally the c3.39 update is live!
The main features of this update are about ship customization, 
with possibility to save/load up to 20 ships,
graphics improvements and performance boost.

there are many other major changes, here's the changelog with some of them:
[h1]
- Brand new aircraft building features, you can now rotate wings and "weld" them together
- save/load up to 20 ships configurations
- Improved the mouse sensitivity slider
- New water effects, light rays, fog, refraction.
- Improved global lighting
- Improved overall graphics
- Improved frame rate
- Improved terrain texture blending
- Fixed some horizon glitches
- Fixed water zfight on far distance
- Added forest support (and some trees too)
- Arena maps have been improved
- Improved sound management
- Fixed many bugs
- Infinite planes now follow the frustum (means glitches on very far distance are now very rare)
[/h1]
